title: Blueberry, Lemon and Poppy Seed Pancakes
excerpt: Fluffy pancakes with the crunch of poppy seeds, lemon zest and whole blueberries that caramelize in the pan.
imageAlt: Fluffy pancakes with fresh blueberries, lemon zest and poppy seeds, freshly made in a skillet

ingredients.text: 270 g all-purpose wheat flour (plain, without leavening)

steps: Combine the flour, salt, sugar, baking powder and zest. Make a well in the center (the volcano method).
Pour the milk, egg and vanilla into the center and mix from the inside out to avoid lumps.
Add the melted butter in a thin stream while mixing. Fold in the blueberries and poppy seeds with a spatula.
Cook in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat. Flip only when bubbles appear on the surface.
tips: If you use frozen blueberries, don’t thaw them: add them straight to the batter so they don’t stain it.
Place a few extra blueberries on each pancake right after pouring the batter into the pan; that way they are spread evenly.
